item.name: Amazon Redshift - G E T_ Rotate Encryption Key

request.name: Amazon Redshift - G E T_ Rotate Encryption Key

description.content: Rotates the encryption keys for a cluster.

query.description:
(Required)

The unique identifier of the cluster that you want to rotate the encryption keys for.

Constraints: Must be the name of valid cluster that has encryption enabled.
